name: Road Maintenance
description: Handles public roadway and sidewalk surface repairs. In scope: potholes, cracked asphalt, damaged road surfaces, broken sidewalk tiles, raised pavement, and pedestrian trip hazards on municipal paths. Out of scope: private driveways, indoor flooring, and stormwater flooding caused primarily by blocked drains (route to Drainage).

name: Waste Management
description: Handles garbage collection, bins, and street cleanliness. In scope: overflowing bins, garbage bags on sidewalks, litter piles, illegal dumping of household trash, and odor from accumulated waste. Out of scope: private indoor trash, hazardous industrial waste requiring specialized handlers, and construction debris that is primarily a road obstruction (may need Road Maintenance coordination).

name: Street Lighting
description: Handles public street and plaza lighting infrastructure. In scope: non-working street lamps, flickering public lights, dark stretches caused by broken municipal fixtures, and damaged light poles for public lighting. Out of scope: private building lights, indoor lighting, and traffic signal lamps (route to Traffic Management).

name: Water Services
description: Handles public water infrastructure leaks and related surface water from pipes. In scope: broken public pipes, continuous clean-water flow from pavement when it has not rained, and visible leaks from municipal water infrastructure. Out of scope: private apartment plumbing with no public impact, and rainwater pooling from blocked storm drains (route to Drainage).

name: Noise Control
description: Handles recurring public noise disturbances that municipalities can investigate. In scope: late-night construction noise, loud generators in public areas, and recurring outdoor noise disturbances. Out of scope: private indoor neighbor disputes without a public nuisance angle, emergency sirens, and noise that is only secondary to another primary issue (for example trash collection odor → Waste Management).

name: Traffic Management
description: Handles traffic signals and intersection control devices. In scope: non-working traffic lights, signals stuck on one color, pedestrian crossing signal failures, and damaged signal heads. Out of scope: general road surface damage without a signal issue (route to Road Maintenance), and street lighting that is not a traffic signal (route to Street Lighting).

name: Drainage
description: Handles stormwater drainage and flood prevention assets. In scope: blocked storm drains, clogged drainage channels, rainwater pooling after rain, and street flooding tied to drainage failure. Out of scope: continuous clean-water leaks unrelated to rain (route to Water Services), and cracked asphalt whose primary repair need is road surface work (route to Road Maintenance).

name: Public Facilities
description: Handles parks, benches, playgrounds, and other public amenities. In scope: broken public benches, damaged playground equipment, unsafe park fixtures, and damaged public amenity structures. Out of scope: private property amenities, roadway pavement (route to Road Maintenance), and waste piled in a park that is primarily a cleanliness issue (route to Waste Management).

name: Water Distribution
description: Handles public water leaks and distribution failures for the Beirut Water Authority.

name: Power Distribution
description: Handles electrical outages and distribution failures for Beirut Electricity Authority.

name: Power Distribution
description: Handles electrical outages and distribution failures for Tripoli Electricity Authority.
